request.prompt: The inside of the same watchtower, drawn as a cutaway elevation with the seaward wall removed so the whole climb reads at once: a stone entry hall at the bottom with an arched doorway, a straight stone stair running up through three floors in flights, small landings and doorways off it, and at the top a square lamp room with a large seaward window. Bare grey blockwork, plain timber landings, iron sconces. Everything is unlit except a little cold moonlight coming through the top window; the lamp itself is dark. No figures, no text.
request.style_note: The Tidewatch, in the same hand throughout: cold night palette of wet black rock, grey weathered stone and a green-black sea, painted concept art with visible brushwork, moonlight as the only warm value, no saturated colour anywhere. Each image is ONE single full-frame view of that place, filling the frame edge to edge: never a sheet, never a grid, never a panel, never an inset or a caption.
